verse.verse_1: By the winds sent forth in swift succession,
verse.verse_2: and then storming on with a tempest's force,
verse.verse_5: by those who bring down the reminder,
verse.verse_6: to excuse some and warn others:
verse.verse_7: that which you have been promised shall be fulfilled.
verse.verse_8: When the stars lose their light,
verse.verse_9: and when the sky is rent asunder,
verse.verse_10: and when the mountains crumble into dust
verse.verse_11: and when the messengers are brought together at the appointed time --
verse.verse_12: for what Day has this been appointed?
verse.verse_14: What will explain to you what the Day of Judgement is?
verse.verse_15: Woe on that Day to those who reject the truth.
verse.verse_16: Did We not destroy the earlier peoples?
verse.verse_17: We will now cause the later ones to follow them:
verse.verse_18: thus do We deal with the culprits.
verse.verse_19: Woe on that Day to those who reject the truth!
verse.verse_20: Did We not create you from a humble fluid,
verse.verse_21: then placed it in a secure repository [the womb],
verse.verse_23: Thus We have determined the stages of development and Our power to determine is excellent indeed.
verse.verse_24: Woe on that Day to those who reject the truth!
verse.verse_25: Have We not made the earth a receptacle,
verse.verse_26: for the living and the dead?
verse.verse_27: Have We not placed high mountains upon it and given you fresh water to drink?
verse.verse_28: Woe on that Day to those who reject the truth!
verse.verse_29: Proceed to that which you denied.
verse.verse_30: Proceed to a shadow rising in three columns:
verse.verse_31: affording neither shade, nor protection from the flames,
verse.verse_32: and throwing up sparks as huge as towers
verse.verse_33: and as bright as a herd of yellow camels.
verse.verse_34: Woe on that Day to those who reject the truth!
verse.verse_35: On that Day they will be speechless,
verse.verse_36: nor shall they be permitted to offer excuses.
verse.verse_37: Woe on that Day to those who reject the truth!
verse.verse_38: This is the Day of Judgement. We have assembled you all together with past generations.
verse.verse_39: If now you have any strategy, use it against Me.
verse.verse_40: Woe on that Day to those who reject the truth!
verse.verse_41: The righteous shall dwell amidst cool shades and fountains,
verse.verse_42: and shall have fruits such as they desire;
verse.verse_43: [They will be told], "Eat and drink with relish in return for what you did [in life]:
verse.verse_44: this is how We reward those who do good."
verse.verse_45: [But] woe on that Day to those who reject the truth!
verse.verse_46: Eat [your fill] and enjoy your life for a little while, O you who are lost in sin.
verse.verse_47: Woe on that Day to those who reject the truth!
verse.verse_48: When they are bidden to bow down, they do not bow down.
verse.verse_49: Woe on that Day to those who reject the truth!
verse.verse_50: In which word then, after this, will they believe?
